correctness.rationale: The externally established homology concentration is for the exact scale and intrinsic graph definition, including n=2. The proof partitions all oriented simplex traces by dimensions: fixed vertices F, fixed and reversed edges \(FD/2-2^{r-1}	au\), and all faces of dimension at least two uniquely assigned to fixed closed-neighborhood centers, contributing F(binomial(a1,2)−a2). Cycle parity is necessary/sufficient for every affine fixed-point equation, so summing and subtracting H0 gives the precise character. Translation averaging proves the exterior-square invariant character for all permutations, with semisimplicity ensuring rational module isomorphism. Exhaustive direct signed-face computations verify all 8,48,384,3840 automorphisms in dimensions 2–5, plus 35 tests in dimension 6. Finite checks are not conflated with proof.

originality.rationale: The 2022 scale-two cube Čech theorem determines only the nonequivariant homotopy type and Betti number. The earlier translation-group character is properly contained in the result but does not determine traces for coordinate permutations or the S_n structure on translation-fixed homology. The new complete semidirect-product character and exterior-square S_n identification go beyond those implications. Relevant exact full-text results and adjacent group-action sources were compared, with unindexed equivalences remaining a risk.

value.rationale: The full hyperoctahedral group is the natural entire symmetry group of the hypercube; determining its all-elements rational homology character is an infinite-family structural classification beyond the published Betti number and known translation-only action. The theorem additionally identifies the translation-fixed S_n-module as the natural exterior square, proving nontrivial coordinate-permutation symmetry and absence of full-group fixed classes. This precise representation is mathematically motivated by equivariant topology of highly symmetric graph complexes; it is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
